name: Saelma & Co AB
note: Parent company of PPY Production AB, the Swedish company behind the Pelle P brand (Allabolag, citing Bolagsverket/UC: 'Moderbolaget är Saelma & Co AB'). Allabolag lists no parent company above it and no owner with their stake; its MD and board member is Marie Cecilia Petterson (Bolagsverket via Allabolag).
